title: Haier reinforces Southeast Asia leadership with next-generation innovations and strategic partnerships

blocks.text: Haier brought together its dealer partners from across Southeast Asia for the SEA Haier Dealer Conference, held under the theme “PLAY WITH NUMBER 1,” aimed to strengthen its commitment to innovation and regional growth,

The regional gathering provided a platform for Haier to showcase its latest home appliance innovations, demonstrate the possibilities of AI-powered smart living, and present its strategic direction and product roadmap for Southeast Asia.

More than a showcase of the brand’s technological capabilities, the conference underscored Haier’s ambition to shape the future of the home appliance industry through continuous innovation, meaningful consumer experiences, and stronger partnerships across the region.
Pushing the boundaries of home appliance innovation

At the center of the conference was an extensive showcase of Haier’s latest product innovations across its home appliance portfolio, spanning refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, televisions, and integrated smart home solutions.

The exhibition gave dealer partners an exclusive opportunity to experience Haier’s newest developments firsthand, explore emerging technologies, and discover how the brand is responding to the evolving needs and expectations of modern households.

One of the notable highlights was Haier’s Laundry Studio, which featured its four-drum washing machine concept. Offering a glimpse into the future of laundry care, the showcase demonstrated Haier’s exploration of innovative product configurations designed to bring greater flexibility, convenience, and intelligent functionality to everyday household routines.

Across its expanding portfolio, Haier continues to push the boundaries of appliance design and technology, combining performance, functionality, and intelligent features to make everyday living more convenient, comfortable, and connected.
Making AI-powered smart living a reality

As artificial intelligence continues to transform the way people interact with technology, Haier placed its AI Smart vision at the forefront of the conference, highlighting how intelligent and connected appliances can create more seamless household experiences.

Through interactive demonstrations and immersive smart home environments, attendees experienced how Haier’s intelligent appliance ecosystem can work together to simplify everyday routines, enhance convenience, and create more connected living spaces.

These demonstrations brought the possibilities of AI-powered living closer to reality, illustrating how technology can go beyond individual appliance functions to deliver a more integrated and intuitive home experience.
By continuing to invest in intelligent technologies and connected solutions, Haier aims to make smart living more accessible, practical, and relevant to the needs of modern consumers.
Charting Haier’s strategic roadmap for Southeast Asia
Beyond product innovation, the conference also served as an important platform for presenting Haier’s strategic direction and product roadmap for Southeast Asia.

The discussions reinforced Haier’s commitment to strengthening its competitive position through consumer-focused innovation, strategic market development, and deeper collaboration with its business partners.

blocks.caption: Mr. Song Yujun Vice President of Haier Smart Home Co., Ltd. and General Manager ofOverseas Markets

blocks.text: By bringing its regional dealer network together around a shared vision, Haier aims to build stronger market alignment, unlock new business opportunities, and establish a solid foundation for sustainable long-term growth throughout Southeast Asia.
A refreshed brand experience that looks to the future
Complementing the product and technology showcases was Haier’s refreshed exhibition environment, featuring a modern, premium, and youthful visual identity.
The redesigned booth experience reflected the brand’s evolving positioning and its ambition to connect with consumers through a more contemporary and engaging expression of smart living.

Designed to encourage exploration and interaction, the exhibition space allowed dealer partners to experience Haier’s diverse product portfolio, engage with its latest technologies, and discover how the brand envisions the homes of tomorrow.
Stronger partnerships, greater shared success
At the heart of the SEA Haier Dealer Conference was a recognition that sustainable business growth is built on strong, collaborative, and enduring partnerships.

Bringing together dealer partners from across the region through meaningful engagement, knowledge sharing, and partner recognition, the conference reaffirmed Haier’s commitment to building a collaborative business ecosystem founded on trust, innovation, and shared ambitions.
By empowering its dealer network and strengthening regional partnerships, Haier aims to bring its innovations closer to consumers while creating greater opportunities for mutual growth and success.
Moving forward together: Play with Number 1
The SEA Haier Dealer Conference marked another important milestone in bringing Haier and its regional partners together around a shared vision for the future.

With continued investments in product innovation, AI-powered smart technologies, strategic market development, and collaborative partnerships, Haier remains focused on advancing smart living and delivering greater value to consumers across Southeast Asia.

As the brand looks toward the future, Haier remains committed to moving forward alongside its dealer partners—embracing innovation, creating new opportunities, and shaping a smarter way of living for households across the region.
Together, let’s PLAY WITH NUMBER 1!
